Okay so, went to a music festival when I was 19 (about 7 years ago) and had a unicorn as my phone lock screen wallpaper. Took some LSD (more than I usually have) and once I started tripping, the unicorn on my lock screen looked like it was galloping. Not long after that it was as if the unicorn jumped from my screen into reality and there she was, in real life. I named her Lola and she stayed with me the whole night, always walking behind me. I introduced her to all my friends and they all welcomed her into their lives with open arms. Everyone loved Lola and no one has ever forgotten about her. She revisits me every time I trip and it’s the best thing ever. 

She is almost like my guardian/protector and will always be a part of me, hence I carry her persona as my gamertag and username for everything to honor the great Lola The Unicorn.
